patch_metadata.summary: Admits the Overlay Weave into the grimoire. The V6 research programme's poetic layer was swept by four parallel seats (46 proverbs, 33 protocols, 17 spells and emoji strings, 26 sci-fi concepts — 122 items, every one anchored file:line to its formal twin), woven into nine threads with a twelve-row casting-forward table (four UNCAST paper seeds), and minted as nine understanding cards that passed the understanding-compression cohere gate first run — understanding-as-key enacted on the research programme itself. Tome IX gains a DRAFT Act 7, The Loomkeeper's Weave. The Loomkeeper enters as a draft persona only.
patch_metadata.supersedes_note: v1.9.2 retires nothing and renames nothing. One draft act, one draft persona (held-open), two overlay artifact registrations, zero conjectures, zero cast.

patch_metadata.honest_framing_guardrail: Overlay artifacts are OVERLAY, not canon: the weave amplifies and never strengthens — every thread's formal-twin line states only what the anchored source states, and the fenced results (the capacity-deficit iff; the CTR-OBS-01 subadditive correction with its equality condition; GR-7 dating of every ceiling) are carried exactly. The Nine Keys are declared-ceremony artifacts (visibility 100%) over the First Person's own corpus; inscribing any key onchain, into spellweb ceremonies, or into a VRC is the First Person's act. The four UNCAST casting-forward directions are unclaimed research seeds, not commitments. Act 7 is DRAFT and unbound; the Loomkeeper is a draft persona and NOT cast.
